current_answer: For the September 15–16 FOMC decision, the directly observed Polymarket contract displayed 79% for a 25-basis-point increase and 20% for no change when accessed at 13:34 UTC on September 12. Against the matched 19:06 UTC September 11 snapshot, those named rows changed −3 and +2 percentage points. The page did not show a quote timestamp and displayed small rounded outcomes, so the movement does not establish an explanation. CME FedWatch remains directly unquoted because its live grid was unreadable. An Axios article reported an 85% CME hike probability after CPI, but without a directly inspectable grid or matched observation time; it is not used for a cross-market spread.
